repo_notes.content: HCCL (Huawei Collective Communication Library) is the collective communication operator library for Ascend AI processors. It sits on top of HCOMM (the communication base library, repo cann/hcomm): HCCL implements collective operators (AllReduce, AllGather, ReduceScatter, Broadcast, Send/Recv, AlltoAllV), algorithm selection, execution templates and channel requests; HCOMM owns topology parsing, PhyTopo/RankGraph construction, endpoints, links and transport. Key source paths: src/ops/{all_reduce,all_gather,...} are per-operator implementations; src/ops/op_common/selector/ is the algorithm selection state machine (registered via REGISTER_SELECTOR_BY_OPTYPE with numeric priority, first MATCH wins); src/ops/op_common/algorithm/topo_match/ matches topology layers; src/ops/op_common/algorithm/executor/ orchestrates hierarchy/resources (V2 pipeline: GetAlgExec -> CalcAlgHierarchyInfo -> CalcRes -> Orchestrate); src/ops/op_common/algorithm/template/ moves data and launches kernels; src/ops/op_common/algorithm/executor/channel/ builds HcclChannelDesc from RankGraph links filtered by engine-allowed protocols. The legacy/ directories contain compatibility paths; new development should target ops/op_common/algorithm and the HCOMM coll_communicator_mgr paths. Documentation already exists under docs/ (build guides, operator development guides); do not duplicate them, focus on source-level architecture.

repo_notes.content: Important version boundary: source follows CANN release tags. The master branch may not match released CANN binaries. When documenting behavior that depends on a specific tag, state the tag/commit. Fields like net_layer semantics in topo.json are enforced by HCOMM parsing; cross-reference the cann/hcomm wiki for parsing contracts instead of re-documenting them here.

pages.title: HCCL Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: HCCL's role between AI frameworks and HCOMM: operator library responsibilities, layering (selector -> executor -> topo match/channel -> template -> transport), and the relationship to cann/hcomm

pages.title: Repository Layout
pages.purpose: Map src/ops (per-operator dirs), src/ops/op_common (algorithm, selector, topo_info), include/, test/{ut,st}, examples/, docs/ and which kind of change lands where

pages.title: Collective Operator Implementation Pattern
pages.purpose: Walk through all_reduce end-to-end as the canonical pattern: OpParam, selector registration, executor creation, template execution, channel usage

pages.title: Selector Framework
pages.purpose: SelectorRegistry, priority ordering, SelectorStatus MATCH/NOT_MATCH semantics, REGISTER_SELECTOR_BY_OPTYPE macro, conflict behavior (HCCL_E_PARA), and how operator-specific selectors encode topology/data-size eligibility

pages.title: AutoSelector State Machine and Fallback
pages.purpose: AutoSelectorBase::Select state machine: Host-DPU-only forcing HOSTCPU+CPU, CCU_MS -> CCU_SCHED -> CCU_FAIL fallback, AIV/AIV_ONLY handling, Stars retry with AICPU_TS, and side effects on OpParam.opExecuteConfig/engine

pages.title: Executor V2 Pipeline
pages.purpose: CollAlgExecRegistryV2::GetAlgExec, CalcAlgHierarchyInfo/V2 (matcher result to sub-comm domains), CalcRes (threads/notify/channel/scratch), Orchestrate (incl. OrchestrateLoop/FastLaunch for AICPU/CCU), and V1 ExecutorBase differences

pages.title: Executor and Template Registration Macros
pages.purpose: REGISTER_EXEC_V2 / REGISTER_EXECUTOR_BY_TOPO / REGISTER_EXECUTOR_BY_TWO_TEMPS / REGISTER_EXEC_V2_MULTI and REGISTER_ALG_ATTRS (topology layers, level-0 topo, PcieMix, dtype/reduce limits) as the second source of selector eligibility

pages.title: Algorithm Templates
pages.purpose: InsAlgTemplateBase contract: TemplateDataParams slicing/stride/loop, TemplateResource channels/streams/notify/scratch, mandatory overrides (CalcRes/KernelRun/FastLaunch/DPUKernelRun), multi-level algorithms combining machine-local and cross-server templates

pages.title: Topology Matching
pages.purpose: TopoMatch implementations (topo_match/): layer-0 Mesh/CLOS collection into algHierarchyInfo.infos[0], cross-server layer matching into infos[1], instance-size consistency checks, and the modulo-based rank filtering convention in TopoMatchUBX with its limitations for sparse/interleaved ranks

pages.title: Channel Construction and Protocol Selection
pages.purpose: channel.cc: GetProtocolByEngine priority table per CommEngine (AICPU/CCU/AIV/CPU/CPU_TS), ProcessLinkForProtocol DIE dedup, CreateChannelFromLink filling HcclChannelDesc, and why a protocol allowlist cannot create a missing RankGraph Link

pages.title: NHR Channel Request Entries
pages.purpose: CalcChannelRequestNhr layer traversal and its layer-0 PCIE-CLOS special case (CLOS/MESH_1D_CLOS + PcieMix + serverNum==1), CalcChannelRequestNhrHighestHostRoce, CalcChannelRequestNhrMultiJetty in-server protocol policy, and the no-link failure path

pages.title: Synchronization via HCOMM Primitives
pages.purpose: How templates call HCOMM through hcomm_primitives.h: channel notify vs thread notify vs data transfer (HcommWrite*) vs fence/sync vs Host-DPU control plane, return-code propagation to HcclResult, and A5 StreamLite vs other-device dispatch

pages.title: Wrapper Synchronization Protocols
pages.purpose: alg_data_trans_wrapper one-way ACK/DATA_SIGNAL flow, bidirectional SendRecvWrite, notify index non-reuse rule, DpuBatchTransfer 3-phase (STEP_SYNC -> NBI writes -> DATA_SIGNAL wait + fence), Host-DPU template ordering (LocalCopy -> BatchModeEnd -> ThreadSynchronize -> SendRequest -> WaitResponse -> BatchModeStart), and Pre/PostSyncInterThreads master-slave sync

pages.title: Graph Mode Interface
pages.purpose: src/ops/interface_graph_mode: graph-mode operator entry points and how they differ from single-operator execution

pages.title: Legacy Paths and Compatibility
pages.purpose: Which legacy/ paths are still live entry points, PreemptPortManager reuse, and the rule that new development targets ops/op_common/algorithm instead
